AI-DLC scope explorer Scopes, Depth, and Test Strategy

Build the /aidlc command that starts your work with exactly the stages you want. The page address keeps your selection, so you can share a plan as a link.

1Pick a scopeEach button is a ready-made plan for one kind of work; the number is how many stages it runs.
2Tick or untick stagesOptional: tailor the plan. Click a phase header to toggle the whole phase. Initialization always runs.
ALWAYS stage CONDITIONAL stage (may skip at runtime when its condition does not hold) per UnitRepeated for each Unit of Work
3Copy the commandand paste it into your AI-DLC chat
Depth: how much detail each stage writes. Test strategy: how many tests Construction writes. Stage reviews: how hard a reviewer agent checks each stage's output.
